notes.title: Update V1.0.3
notes.content:
- Added Villa Carlos Paz Snow shakedown stage
- Toyoda camera position improved
- Stage progress added into UI
- Fixed bug: missing time of some AI cars at the end
- Cordoba Long: fixed some rocks flying
- San Juan: improved starting grid and layout for IA cars. Beacon of waypoint 5 widened
- La Rioja: fixed roadbook distances
- Fiambala Long: fixed missing audio in spanish
- Jujuy: fixed some rocks flying and beacon of waypoint 2 widened
- Oruro Long: improved environment at the finish zone
- Shadow Forest: fixed layout

notes.title: V1.0.1
notes.content:
- The race can be skipped when the player ends
- The game also can be saved from the Pre Race panel
- Added support for a second joystick
- Removed autoscroll with some devices in controller configuration section
- Fixed collision box of Armath player cars
- Improved crash audio
- Fixed some trees flying in Snowden Forest West Loop
